authorizationSemantics: Every authorization boolean records whether THIS MC-15 planning artefact authorizes the action. No MC-15 artefact authorizes publication, indexation, sitemap membership, commercial transaction, deployment, redirect execution or live route creation, so every boolean is false. A false value is not a statement that an existing corporate page is unpublished.
patternConvention: es/en hold the pattern without a leading slash, exactly as registered in the MC-15 data contract section 2.4 and in the LOCALIZED_ROUTES convention (src/app/core/i18n/locale-routes.ts). routePatternEs/routePatternEn add the leading slash for human and table use only.

rules: CORE_COMMERCE: GATE-IP-CLEARANCE, GATE-CRA-CYBERSECURITY, GATE-CONSUMER-TERMS, GATE-COMMERCIAL-CLAIMS, GATE-PRICING, GATE-PAYMENTS, GATE-LEGAL-ENTITY and GATE-WEBSITE-REMEDIATION are attached to every route that presents a commercial offer, quote or product identity, because MC-14 attaches those gates to all nine families and all six bundles.
FAMILY_GATE_MATRIX: a family route receives every gate whose productFamilyIds list contains that family.
BUNDLE_GATE_MATRIX: a bundle route receives every gate whose bundleIds list contains that bundle.

UNION_OF_PRESENTED_NODES: a hub or tool route that presents every family and bundle receives the union of their gates; the configurator receives the same union minus GATE-PAYMENTS because it produces a quotation request and no checkout.

NON_COMMERCE_PAGE_TYPES: professionals and installers receive brand, claims, legal, remediation and contract gates; support receives brand, claims, legal, remediation and CRA gates; documentation receives the same plus data-licensing and PILOT safety gates because manuals cover charts, weather and PILOT instructions.
